# Where an error happened: every case here fails, and "--- at" pins the
# line and column (both from 1, the column in bytes) the runtime reports.
# The innermost expression that failed is the place; a parse error is where
# the text stops making sense, or where a list or string that never closes
# was opened.

=== an error on a later line
(def x 1)
(def y 2)
(+ x "y")
--- error
--- at 3:1
--- message expected number, got string

=== an error in a nested call is the inner call
(+ 1
   (* 2
      (- "three" 1)))
--- error
--- at 3:7
--- message expected number, got string

=== an error inside a function is where the body fails
(def half (fn (n)
  (/ n 2)))
(half "four")
--- error
--- at 2:3
--- message expected number, got string

=== an error in a let body
(let ((a 1)
      (b "two"))
  (+ a b))
--- error
--- at 3:3
--- message expected number, got string

=== an error in a let binding
(let ((a 1)
      (b (head (list))))
  (+ a b))
--- error
--- at 2:10
--- message head of empty list

=== an error in a cond clause
(def pick (fn (x)
  (cond
    ((= x 1) "one")
    ((= x 2) (str-missing x))
    (#t "many"))))
(pick 2)
--- error
--- at 4:15
--- message undefined global: str-missing

=== an error in a closure called by map
(map (fn (x)
       (* x x))
     (list 1 "b" 3))
--- error
--- at 2:8
--- message expected number, got string

=== an error in a closure called by fold
(fold (fn (acc x)
        (+ acc x))
      0
      (list 1 2 "c"))
--- error
--- at 2:9
--- message expected number, got string

=== an error in a builtin called by map as a value is the map call
(map -
  (list 1 "x"))
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message expected number, got string

=== calling a non-function
(def f 42)
(do
  (f 1))
--- error
--- at 3:3
--- message attempt to call non-function (got number)

=== the wrong number of arguments
(def two (fn (a b) (+ a b)))
(two
  1)
--- error
--- at 2:1
--- message function expects 2 arguments, got 1

=== an undefined global
(def a 1)
  (+ a missing-name)
--- error
--- at 2:8
--- message undefined global: missing-name

=== an explicit error
(def check (fn (v)
  (if (< v 0)
      (error "negative")
      v)))
(check 1)
(check -1)
--- error
--- at 3:7
--- message negative

=== letv with the wrong arity
(letv (a b c)
  (tuple 1 2)
  (+ a b))
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message letv arity mismatch

=== an unterminated list is where it opens
(def x 1)
(+ x
   (* 2 3)
--- error
--- at 2:1
--- message unterminated list

=== an unterminated string is where it opens
(def s "abc)
(str-len s)
--- error
--- at 1:8
--- message unterminated string literal

=== an unsupported escape is the escaped character
(def s "a\qb")
--- error
--- at 1:11
--- message unsupported escape: \q

=== an unexpected close is where it is
(+ 1 2))
--- error
--- at 1:8
--- message expected token

=== a bad boolean literal
(if #yes 1 2)
--- error
--- at 1:5
--- message invalid boolean literal

=== a byte order mark is not a column
﻿(+ 1
   "a")
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message expected number, got string
